suggestions.quote: In a study this year, more than 1,300 Americans read a personal message (c20). Told it was written by AI, they called the sender lazy and insincere (c20). Told nothing, most never suspected (c20).
suggestions.fix: In a 2026 study, more than 1,300 Americans read a personal message (c20). Told it was written by AI, they called the sender lazy and insincere (c20). Told nothing, most never suspected (c20).

keep.quote: Around the turn of the century, the Philippines was called the texting capital of the world (c01). By 2008, Filipinos sent over a billion texts a day (c02).

In a 2023 study, people who suspected their chat partner was using AI-suggested replies judged them more harshly (c22). But actually using them made the conversation warmer and closer (c22). The use never hurt the conversation. The suspicion did (c22).
One security company estimated that in 2024, bots, good and bad, passed people: 51 per cent of all web traffic, for the first time in a decade (c09).
